product_one_liner.value: Perceptyx provides an AI-powered employee experience platform for enterprises that gathers employee feedback and turns insights into action through listening, learning, and activation tools.
product_one_liner.notes: Homepage positions Perceptyx as an AI-powered employee experience platform with employee surveys, analytics, and actionable insights.

pricing_page.notes: Homepage review found no public pricing page or pricing link; its product pages route prospects to contact/demo rather than listing pricing.

named_customers.notes: Both are presented as Perceptyx customer case studies on its customer stories page.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists the company size as 201–500 employees.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies Temecula, California, as headquarters.

founded_year.notes: Perceptyx's company blog identifies its founding as 2003.

eng_blog.notes: The blog index shows research, company news, product launches, and marketing content, not at least two engineering-authored posts on building the product.

public_docs.notes: The developer portal and public Customer Care help center provide multiple product documentation and support articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The careers page links to the current job board, but the accessible board page does not list any current roles.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed the AI/security information and public product material; no specific AI model provider is publicly identified.

compliance_certs.notes: The trust center names SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001:2022, and GDPR. Other named frameworks or authorizations are omitted because the question asks only for the listed items.

last_funding.notes: The latest funding identified is TCV's strategic investment announced in August 2019. The announcement does not disclose an amount, so amount_usd is 0 rather than an estimated value.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest funding found is dated 2019-08, outside the 18-month lookback from 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The current job board page does not list any open roles.

launched_6mo.notes: The blog index announces Perceptyx Anywhere on September 29, 2026, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: A June 25, 2026, post states that Mary Poppen joined Perceptyx as Chief Customer Officer.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The developer portal, integrations page, and accessible job board were reviewed; none of these pages names a CRM or sales/marketing system in use.
